verdict.rationale: Carta is a SaaS equity-management platform with an API and MCP plugins, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any such setting, toggle or policy, and the community complaints about sales outreach concern data misuse rather than a telemetry opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
